description: This file defines extension methods for ISiloPersistentStreamConfigurator to configure Azure-specific deployment queue balancers in Orleans. It provides static methods to set up dynamic and static Azure deployment load balancers based on Azure deployment info and membership status.

classes.name: SiloPersistentStreamConfiguratorExtension
classes.description: Contains extension methods for configuring Azure deployment queue balancers for silo persistent streams.

methods.name: UseDynamicAzureDeploymentBalancer
methods.description: Configures the stream to use a dynamic, Azure deployment-based queue balancer that rebalances queues based on Azure deployment info and current silo statuses.

methods.name: UseStaticAzureDeploymentBalancer
methods.description: Configures the stream to use a static, Azure deployment-based queue balancer that relies only on Azure deployment info without considering dynamic membership changes.
